metadata.sql: SELECT year, round, grand_prix, driver_name, driver_code, surname, constructor, position, points, finish_time FROM v_race_results WHERE year = 2023 AND (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%bahrain%' OR lower(circuit_country) LIKE '%bahrain%') AND position = 1
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2023 Bahrain Grand Prix?
